title: release-dsh-plugin

requirements.summary: Release only the DSH adapter artifact family to the npm registry.
acceptanceCriteria: Only the DSH adapter fourth segment and package.json version are bumped.
Focused adapter build, tests, and checks pass; the tarball contains lib/, skills/, cordis.patch.yml.
The exact vdsh-<version> tag points to clean origin/main.
@veewo/dsh-claw-kit@<version> is published to the npm registry and installable via `dsh plugin add`.

tasks.title: Inspect and classify the DSH release baseline
tasks.detail: Read AGENTS.md and references/artifact.md; inspect branch, remotes, vdsh-* tags, package.json, and every worktree change. Resolve the CLI base version (authorized CLI candidate or current published @veewo/claw). Reject unapproved cross-family changes.

tasks.title: Prepare the DSH adapter version
tasks.detail: Set packages/dsh-adapter/package.json to <cli-base>.<next-fourth-segment> derived from prior vdsh-<cli-base>.* tags; review the full diff.

tasks.title: Verify the DSH plugin candidate
tasks.detail: Run npm run build/test/check -w @veewo/dsh-claw-kit, export the tarball, verify its contents, and run npm run publish:dsh-plugin (dry run) to confirm the artifact gate.

tasks.title: Pass the exact-source gate and release
tasks.detail: Commit intended content on main, push origin/main, require an empty worktree and HEAD == origin/main, run npm run publish:dsh-plugin --publish, then create and push vdsh-<version>.

tasks.title: Verify the immutable DSH release
tasks.detail: Verify the published npm version, the vdsh-<version> tag, repository cleanliness, and (when separately authorized) a real-profile install: dsh plugin --profile web add @veewo/dsh-claw-kit + restart + claw_run/skills present.

references.why: Owns the DSH adapter release contract.

rules: Publish only @veewo/dsh-claw-kit to npm; never publish CLI/core or another adapter.
Never modify another artifact family without explicit batch authority.
Stop at the first failed release boundary.
